description: Built-in NPDev products pack: the single product and service register every other pack points at. A product is what you sell, buy or stock, identified by its SKU. Selling price, purchase cost and stock levels are not here: the sales, purchasing and inventory packs keep their own data about a product in a satellite that points back to it, so the product itself is registered once.
author: NPDev

metadata.summary: One register of products and services, identified by SKU, with a unit of measure. Sales, purchasing and inventory all point at it instead of keeping their own copy.
reviewNotes: A product has one unit of measure. Say whether you buy in one unit and sell in another (box of 12 vs unit).
No variants (size, colour): each variant is its own product with its own SKU. Say whether you need variants grouped under one product.
No categories yet. Say how you group products, if at all.
